name: John Carr
role: Father of Dick Carr, of Delavan, Ill.
mentions: John Carr, of Delavan, Ill., is here visiting his son Dick, whom he had not seen for twelve years.
We are indebted to Mr. John Carr of Delavan, Ill., for late papers from his home. He returned home from his visit to Dick, with a very much and favorably changed idea of Dakota.
